notes: The ground this area owns (86,100 m2, 291 points): the band north of the Student Center and south of the Ice Arena, east of the railway. Names (the university's where known; OpenStreetMap for positions only): Yogi Berra Drive from the railway bridge to the north-east area; Carlisle Road from the west area's cut north to the Ice Arena drive; Webster Road from the west area's cut to Lot 17; Quad Road; Stone Street north of Stone Hall; Blanton Road; Lot 17, Lot 38, the north end of Lot 30 and the unnamed lot south of the Ice Arena (OSM 313030643); Webster Hall, Irvin D. Reid Hall and the Red Hawk Diner (none in the published model). 'webster' is the area's label only: Webster Road runs through it and Webster Hall stands in it. Webster Hall still stands in the newest USGS NAIP Plus mosaic (leaf-on, after 2020). West: 3.4 m east of the rail ballast's east edge (published Ballast/Rail ties meshes: x = -295.5 + 0.4408 (y - 330), a straight run), from the west area's north-west corner (-285.89, 344.1) to the Ice Arena drive; round the east end of the Yogi Berra Drive bridge 1.5 m outside the deck (LiDAR class 17, x -266..-222): the road over the railway is left to the published model. South-west: the west area's own vertices, reused exactly: its cut across Carlisle Road (-257.14, 331.11)-(-285.89, 344.1), the east side of Lot 30's walk down to (-289.33, 255.06) and Webster Road's north-west edge back to its cut across Webster Road (-201.1, 317.7)-(-195.25, 306.55); the wooded wedge between them (north model terrain) is taken. South: University Hall (north model) 1 m out, 0.2 m inside the edge of the main model's walk along its north wall (SB_footway), round the published WS24 junction of Webster Road (Joe's photos) 0.2 m inside its asphalt, the Student Center Annex and its north-east deck, the Student Center 1 m out; Lot 38 and the garden east of it are inside; down the main model's walks (QS_footway, QW_footway) 0.2 m inside their outer edge round Irvin D. Reid Hall, which adjoins Richardson Hall (Richardson 1 m out; Reid's last metre at Richardson's wall lies outside); up the west edge of the published Stone Street (QS/QW_service) 0.2 m inside it to its north end (y 352), across it and its east walk, east to Bohn Hall. East: 0.5 m inside Bohn Hall's west walls, its courtyard and north landing (see free_edges), then straight north at x 232..234 to the north-east area's edge at (232, 497), a point on its segment (205, 497)-(300, 497). North: the north-east area's vertices reused exactly, (205, 497), (176, 499), then round Blanton Hall (main model) 1 m out on its south side and both ends: the 5 m strip between Blanton's north-west wall and the north-east edge (90, 455)-(176, 499) stays with the main model; then (90, 455), (60, 468), (4, 450), (-22, 440), (-56, 431) and up the north-east area's west edge x -56 to (-56, 598), with its two notches round the Energy Plant's west end and the west cooling tower block (0.3 m inside their walls: the plant is the north-east area's; same vertices in both footprints, seam pass 2026-11-20); 1 m south of the Ice Arena's south wall, 0.2 m inside the published arena walk and drive aisle (KP IceArena SSW, north model), and square across Carlisle Road at y 600..612 to the railway. Published things left standing inside the outline (not ground): building 313028541 by the substation and building 232853526 north of Webster Road (north model), the Lot 38 roll-off containers (main), 54 published tree groups. Left out: the ground west of the railway (the TV Tower and the building beside it, Yogi Berra Drive west of the bridge and its junction with Clove Road): a footprint is one ring and cannot cross the rail cutting except on the bridge, which the engine cannot build; that ground touches the village area's south-east edge. Evidence in /workspace/data/webster: ortho2020 (x -330..250, y 260..630, 0.15 m), lidar.npz (x -370..290, y 250..670, 0.5 m), osm.json, tiles (dump of models/main for x -380..300, y 240..680, with instances; ground.png from plan.py), tiles_plain (no instances; plan.png). Edge heights: 2506 samples; away from the scripted neighbours and outside the free_edges ring they lie within 0.06 m (median) of the LiDAR ground, 95 % within 0.41 m. Fix-up pass (2026-11-20): a notch 2.8 m wide takes the ground under Reid Hall's link up to 0.5 m past Richardson Hall's wall (see free_edges); the main tiles need exporting again before supersede.mjs runs.

free_edges.why: Bohn Hall (main model): the published ground beside its west face, courtyard and north landing is the coarse 4 km skirt, 1.0 to 2.0 m under the LiDAR ground (edge samples 132.1-134.6 m against 134.0-135.4 m). The edge runs 0.5 m inside the walls there, so that ground is clipped and hidden, and follows this area's own grade instead of dipping 2 m to the skirt in front of the wall.

Irvin D. Reid Hall's link to Richardson Hall (main model): the footprint runs 0.5 m under Richardson's tower wall for the width of the link only, so the link lies inside; the main model's ground there is hidden inside Richardson, and the edge follows this area's own grade.

supersede.notes: Patterns match 'mesh name material name' in the other sources' tiles. clip, their ground inside the footprint (top-view m2 inside, from the dump): Context_skirt_3DEP_ortho_4km 80515, North_terrain_LiDAR_1m and M3a_north_LiDAR_DTM_1m_ext (North_ground_ortho2020) 26640 and 19864, WF_east_dorm_LiDAR_terrain_patch 20821, QW_DTM_north_edge_ramp 2312, RZ2_SC_LiDAR_ground_patch 1270, MH LiDAR edge apron N of Annex 228, PK_Feliciano_west_DTM_fill 77; MH_ground_ortho2020 and BD_farfield_3DEP are listed so that any of their ground under the outline goes too. Also clipped, because this area redraws them from the ortho and they run on past the outline: the main model's OSM strips SG_QuadRoad_full (1689 m2; it lies 3 to 5 m south of the road in the ortho east of x 60), SG_WebsterRoad_313028543 (490), SF_Lot38_asphalt (868; the skirt shows through it), and its walks SF_footway_313028550 (272), SF_footway_313028555 (105) and TR_footway_546643369_S_gap (87). drop: SG_Lot38_curbs and SG_Lot38_oil_stains (they sit on the replaced Lot 38 asphalt), far_houses. Kept: WS24 (Webster Road junction by the Annex), the Student Center's and Richardson's walks and plazas, the published Stone Street south of y 352, the Ice Arena walk and drive aisle, the Lot 38 containers, every building and tree.
